content_zh:
为什么是在门口，因为她不想惊动苏子宁。
对于陈阳，叶以晴讨厌之余，心里更多的是好奇，一个用着老款诺基亚的穷小子，却拥有不俗的功夫和神奇的车技，这家伙身上，一定隐藏着秘密。
当陈阳走到四合院门口，叶以晴冷不丁开口道：“你开车挺厉害的嘛，竟然还会玩特技。”
陈阳转头看向叶以晴，夜晚的昏黄灯光下，警花的身材显得更加挺拔丰满，矗立在那里，加上冷厉的表情，颇有几分风情。
“我不玩特技的话，难道你希望亲手抓自己的房东，那多尴尬。”
陈阳耸了耸肩，并没有遮遮掩掩，在老捷达飞跃警车的刹那，他就已经注意到躲在警车后的叶以晴了。
叶以晴冷哼一声，凶神恶煞道：“我可不介意抓自己的房东，而且是你这种道德沦丧，人品败坏，危害社会治安的坏房东。”
陈阳慵懒地靠在了门旁，笑道：“叶警官，话可不能乱说，你要抓我，你有证据吗？”
“我亲眼目睹你飙车，而且身上还坐了个非主流女人，开车还玩女人，你可真是恶心。”叶以晴说着，做了个呕吐的动作。
陈阳不以为意，迈步朝着四合院里走去：“就你看见了吗？呵呵，这么说你就是没证据咯，没证据就想抓人，这哪里是警察，根本就是女流氓。”
叶以晴美眸一瞪，最终还是按捺住了火气，等陈阳进了房间，她拿出一本驾照在手上拍了拍，得意笑道：“哼，我把你的驾照分扣光，看你以后还敢不敢飙车。”
陈阳一进自己的房间，就发现有人进来过的痕迹，查看了下，只是少了本驾照，他顿时明白怎么回事。
“这小妞也太天真了，以为把我的驾照拿走，我就不能开车了？”
陈阳笑了起来，丝毫没有在意消失的驾照，别说是驾照，就算是身份证，对他来说也没有任何意义，这些都是组里人知道他回东安市，硬要给他办的。
第二天一大早，陈阳习惯性地早起，护士关兮月值夜班还没回来，警花叶以晴在院子中间练着拳法。
叶以晴穿着一件紧身的白色T恤，黑色的运动裤，充满了活力。随着她挥拳踢腿的动作，峰峦大幅度的颤动，把刚刚走出房间的陈阳看得眼睛都直了。
更受不了的是，叶以晴为了方便，竟然没有穿内衣，汗液浸湿了衣服一小片区域，贴在身上，几乎是透明的。
陈阳一本正经地走到了叶以晴的正面，指点道：“把手抬高点，直拳发出时要绷直手臂，力量才能发挥出来。”
叶以晴看向陈阳，本来不想听他的，但还是不由自主的照做，一拳打出，发出啪的破空响声。
她顿时心头大喜，可抬头一看，只见陈阳一脸坏笑，正盯着自己敞开的短袖袖口，顺着腋窝往里看。

“混蛋，让我把手臂抬高绷直，竟然是为了偷看！”
叶以晴心头大怒，挥拳就朝陈阳打了过去。
正在此时，苏子宁从厨房走了出来：“以晴，陈阳，吃早饭了。”
“哼！”
叶以晴不想在苏子宁面前和陈阳动手，冷哼了声，回房洗漱换衣服去了。
苏子宁走到陈阳旁边，问道：“怎么了，你又惹以晴生气了？”
“谁知道呢，我指点她练拳，她好像有些不乐意。”
陈阳嘿嘿一笑，转头看向苏子宁，只见后者身上又是一套款式花色和昨天不同的旗袍，虽然围着围裙，展露不出身材来，但却别有风情。
“人家是跆拳道黑带，用得着你指点练拳？”苏子宁笑了笑，拉着陈阳进了饭厅。
吃过早饭后，陈阳把爷爷留下的一辆六八年经典款凤凰牌二八大杠骑了出来，这辆车年月已久，虽然擦得干干净净，但却锈迹斑斑，骑起来嘎吱嘎吱地作响，和破烂几乎没有区别。
不过他一点也不嫌弃，因为小的时候他就坐在大杠上，爷爷骑车带他出去玩，这辆车承载着他儿时的回忆。
“找不着驾照，也不用骑这辆破车吧。”
叶以晴看着骑二八大杠出了四合院的陈阳，一边喝着粥，一边嘟哝道。
苏子宁笑了笑，眼中闪过回忆之色：“这是陈老的车，陈阳小时候一直想骑，但却够不着。”
叶以晴愣了下，心里给陈阳又加上了一个“念旧”的标签，越发觉得搞不懂陈阳了。

content_en:
Why was it at the door? Because she didn't want to alarm Su Zining.
For Chen Yang, Ye Yiqing hated Chen Yang, but she was more curious in her heart. A poor boy who used an old Nokia, but had good kung fu and miraculous driving skills. There must be a secret hidden in this guy.
When Chen Yang walked to the door of the courtyard, Ye Yiqing suddenly said: "You are very good at driving, and you can even do stunts."
Chen Yang turned to look at Ye Yiqing. Under the dim light at night, the policewoman's figure looked even taller and plumper. Standing there, with a cold and stern expression, she was quite charming.
"If I didn't do any stunts, would you want to catch your landlord with your own hands? That would be so embarrassing."
Chen Yang shrugged and did not hide anything. The moment the old Jetta jumped over the police car, he had already noticed Ye Yiqing hiding behind the police car.
Ye Yiqing snorted coldly and said fiercely: "I don't mind arresting my own landlord, and it's a bad landlord like you who has lost morals, has a corrupt character, and endangers social security."
Chen Yang lazily leaned against the door and said with a smile: "Officer Ye, don't talk nonsense. If you want to arrest me, do you have any evidence?"
"I witnessed you racing a car with a non-mainstream woman sitting on top of you. You were driving and playing with women. You are really disgusting." Ye Yiqing said, making a vomiting motion.
Chen Yang didn't take it seriously and walked towards the courtyard: "Did you see it? Haha, so you just have no evidence and you want to arrest people without evidence. This is not a policeman, she is just a female hooligan."
Ye Yiqing's beautiful eyes widened, and she finally suppressed her anger. When Chen Yang entered the room, she took out a driver's license, patted it on her hand, and said with a proud smile: "Humph, I will deduct all the points on your driver's license to see if you dare to race in the future."
As soon as Chen Yang entered his room, he found signs that someone had come in. After checking, he found that his driver's license was missing. He immediately understood what was going on.
"This girl is so naive. She thinks that if she takes away my driver's license, I won't be able to drive?"
Chen Yang laughed and didn't care at all about the disappearing driver's license. Let alone a driver's license, even an ID card meant nothing to him. These were all things the team members insisted on getting for him when they knew he was back in Dong'an City.
Early the next morning, Chen Yang got up early as usual. Nurse Guan Xiyue had not returned from her night shift, and policewoman Ye Yiqing was practicing boxing in the middle of the yard.
Ye Yiqing was wearing a tight white T-shirt and black sweatpants, full of energy. As she punched and kicked, the mountains trembled greatly, making Chen Yang's eyes wide open as he just walked out of the room.
What's even more unbearable is that Ye Yiqing didn't wear underwear for convenience. The sweat soaked a small area of ​​​​the clothes and stuck to her body, making it almost transparent.
Chen Yang walked up to Ye Yiqing in a serious manner and pointed: "Raise your hands higher. When sending out a straight punch, you must straighten your arms so that your strength can be exerted."
Ye Yiqing looked at Chen Yang. She didn't want to listen to him at first, but she still obeyed involuntarily and punched out, making a cracking sound.
She was immediately overjoyed, but when she looked up, she saw Chen Yang with a wicked smile on his face, staring at the open cuffs of his short sleeves and looking in along his armpits.
"Asshole, you asked me to raise my arms and straighten them just to take a peek!"
Ye Yiqing was furious and punched Chen Yang.
At this moment, Su Zining came out of the kitchen: "Yi Qing, Chen Yang, it's time to have breakfast."
"Hmph!"
Ye Yiqing didn't want to fight Chen Yang in front of Su Zining, so she snorted coldly and went back to her room to wash up and change clothes.
Su Zining walked up to Chen Yang and asked, "What's wrong? Did you make Yi Qing angry again?"
"Who knows, I taught her how to practice boxing, but she seemed a little unhappy."
Chen Yang chuckled and turned to look at Su Zining. He saw that the latter was wearing another set of cheongsam with a different style and color from yesterday. Although he was wearing an apron, he couldn't show anything.She has a good figure, but has a unique style.
"I have a black belt in Taekwondo, do I need your guidance on how to practice boxing?" Su Zining smiled and pulled Chen Yang into the dining room.
After breakfast, Chen Yang rode out a classic 1968 Phoenix brand 28-bar left behind by his grandfather. This car was old, and although it was wiped clean, it was stained with rust. It made a squeaking sound when riding, and was almost indistinguishable from a rag.
But he doesn't dislike it at all, because when he was a child, he sat on the big bar and his grandfather took him out to play on a bicycle. This car carries his childhood memories.
"I can't find my driver's license, so there's no need to ride this crappy bike."
Ye Yiqing looked at Chen Yang who was riding a large pole out of the courtyard, and muttered while drinking porridge.
Su Zining smiled, with memories flashing in his eyes: "This is Mr. Chen's car. Chen Yang always wanted to ride it when he was a child, but he couldn't reach it."
Ye Yiqing was stunned for a moment, and added another label of "nostalgic" to Chen Yang in her heart, feeling more and more confused about Chen Yang.
